say:3:1223205001:1.text: Argh! Can't believe you're siding with the Water Wights to hurt honest folks like myself! I'm going to tell everyone about this!
say:3:1223205001:1.source_cn: 可恶，你们居然帮水鬼欺负我，我要告诉所有人！

say:4:1223205002:1.text: Don't try and spin this like we're the bad guys. Thoreau did work for you. You have to pay him—plain and simple.
say:4:1223205002:1.source_cn: 别颠倒是非，既然他给你干了活，不管怎样，你要付干活的钱。

say:5:1223205003:1.text: As for your past grievances, that's a different matter.
say:5:1223205003:1.source_cn: 至于之前的恩怨，那是另一回事。

say:6:1223205004:1.text: Precisely. Chippy hates it when people abuse their power to settle personal scores! Keeping things separate is the mark of a true knight!
say:6:1223205004:1.source_cn: 没错，满满最讨厌公报私仇。一码归一码，才是骑士的美德！

say:7:1223205005:1.text: If you keep bullying Thoreau, we'll send you to the Carmine Whispers. They'll give you a fair trial!
say:7:1223205005:1.source_cn: 你要是栽赃陷害，我们就把你送去血薇帮，他们会给恶人公平...

say:8:1223205006:1.text: Wait! I was just messing with you just now! Here's what I agreed to pay... Or you can have all of it!
say:8:1223205006:1.source_cn: 别！我刚才跟你们开玩笑呢，这是答应给水鬼的钱，啊不，全...

say:14:1223205008:1.text: Thoreau, only take what's rightfully yours.
say:14:1223205008:1.source_cn: 梭罗，只拿该拿的那一份。

say:15:1223205009:0.text: B—But... it's free money. Didn't you teach us to seize everything we can before?
say:15:1223205009:0.source_cn: 可、可是……不拿白不拿，水鬼就该连拿带兜，这不是你教我...

say:16:1223205010:1.text: That's when we were robbers. Things are different now.
say:16:1223205010:1.source_cn: 那是做劫匪的时候，和现在能一样吗？

say:17:1223205011:1.text: Alright, I hear ya... This is all for our new life.
say:17:1223205011:1.source_cn: 行吧，听你的，为了……新生活！

say:18:1223205012:1.text: Keep your filthy money! We aren't thugs anymore! We only take what's ours!
say:18:1223205012:1.source_cn: 喂！拿走你的臭钱！我们现在不是劫匪了！只拿该拿的！

say:19:1223205013:1.text: You actually have principles now. It's my fault for underestimating you.
say:19:1223205013:1.source_cn: 没想到你们还挺有原则，小看你们了。

say:20:1223205014:1.text: What are you looking at? Go away!

say:21:1223205015:1.text: Hmph, once a Water Wight, always a Water Wight! You'll never change!
say:21:1223205015:1.source_cn: 哼，再怎么变，一天是水鬼，一辈子都是水鬼，认命吧！

say:25:1223205016:1.text: These people are getting under my skin! When will they stop disrespecting me?
say:25:1223205016:1.source_cn: 真烦！一个两个的，都朝老子吐口水，什么时候是个头？

say:26:1223205017:1.text: Be patient. The sun always rise above the sea, and we're experts at waiting on the water, remember?
say:26:1223205017:1.source_cn: 耐心一点，海上的太阳总会升起。咱们最擅长的，不就是等太...

say:27:1223205018:1.text: By the way, where's Cecil? Isn't he with you?
say:27:1223205018:1.source_cn: 对了，西索呢，不是和你在一起吗？

say:28:1223205019:1.text: He went to another street to look for work, and he's been away for quite some time. He could've run into some trouble as well.
say:28:1223205019:1.source_cn: 他去另外一条街找活了，这么久不回来，八成也碰到挑事情的了。

say:29:1223205020:1.text: Let's check on him. Bring me there.
